details.question: 统计各地区的销售总额
details.sql: SELECT dim_region.region_name, SUM(fact_order.order_amount) AS GMV FROM fact_order JOIN dim_region ON fact_order.region_id = dim_region.region_id GROUP BY dim_region.region_name ORDER BY GMV DESC
details.gold_sql: SELECT r.region_name, SUM(f.order_amount) AS total_amount FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id = r.region_id GROUP BY r.region_name ORDER BY r.region_name
details.normalized_sql: select dim_region.region_name, sum(fact_order.order_amount) as gmv from fact_order join dim_region on fact_order.region_id = dim_region.region_id group by dim_region.region_name order by gmv desc

details.question: GMV最高的5个商品

SELECT dim_product.product_name, SUM(fact_order.order_amount) AS GMV
FROM fact_order
JOIN dim_product ON fact_order.product_id = dim_product.product_id
GROUP BY dim_product.product_name
ORDER BY GMV DESC
LIMIT 5
details.gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(f.order_amount) AS gmv FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY gmv DESC, p.product_id LIMIT 5
details.normalized_sql: select dim_product.product_name, sum(fact_order.order_amount) as gmv from fact_order join dim_product on fact_order.product_id = dim_product.product_id group by dim_product.product_name order by gmv desc limit 5

details.question: 华东地区女性客户的消费总额
details.sql:
SELECT SUM(fact_order.order_amount) AS GMV
FROM fact_order
JOIN dim_region ON fact_order.region_id = dim_region.region_id
JOIN dim_customer ON fact_order.customer_id = dim_customer.customer_id
WHERE dim_region.region_name = '华东'
  AND dim_customer.gender = '女'
details.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(f.order_amount) AS total_amount FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id = r.region_id JOIN dim_customer c ON f.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE r.region_name = '华东' AND c.gender = '女'

details.question: 华为品牌在广东省的销量
details.sql:
SELECT dim_product.brand, dim_region.province, SUM(fact_order.order_quantity) AS total_quantity
FROM fact_order
JOIN dim_product ON fact_order.product_id = dim_product.product_id
JOIN dim_region ON fact_order.region_id = dim_region.region_id
WHERE dim_product.brand = '华为' AND dim_region.province = '广东省'
GROUP BY dim_product.brand, dim_region.province
details.gold_sql: SELECT p.brand, r.province, SUM(f.order_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id = r.region_id JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.brand = '华为' AND r.province = '广东省' GROUP BY p.brand, r.province
details.normalized_sql: select dim_product.brand, dim_region.province, sum(fact_order.order_quantity) as total_quantity from fact_order join dim_product on fact_order.product_id = dim_product.product_id join dim_region on fact_order.region_id = dim_region.region_id where dim_product.brand = '华为' and dim_region.province = '广东省' group by dim_product.brand, dim_region.province
